items.stem: Why do neural MT systems use subword (e.g. BPE) tokenisation?

options.text: It represents rare and unseen words as known subword units

Speed is not the main reason.

options.text: It removes the need for parallel data

options.rationale: Fluency is not guaranteed by tokenisation alone.
